top_signals.title: Anthony Scaramucci's "All the Wrong Moves"
top_signals.summary: Former Trump Administration official and Founder of Skybridge, Anthony Scaramucci, is out with a new book "All the Wrong Moves: How Three Catastrophic Decisions Led to the Rise of Trump." He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the lessons he learned from his time on Wall Street to his short-lived time in the White House and extended exposure to the Trump-world. He tries to make the case for what bipartisan money mistakes lead to today's "political crisis" and how we can get out of it. (Source: Bloomberg)

alerts.title: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services, July 2026
alerts.summary: The U.S. goods and services trade deficit increased in July 2026 according to the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and the U.S. Census Bureau. The deficit increased from $71.2 billion in June (revised) to $88.6 billion in July, as imports increased and exports decreased. The goods deficit increased $17.6 billion in July to $119.6 billion. The services surplus increased $0.2 billion in July to $31.0 billion.
